title: content-validate: validate grade field values + positive grade-ordering test
description: Follow-up from PR #36 adversarial review (rw-385). The grade-monotonicity check and the existing grade-order prereq check both read GRADE_ORDER[grade], which returns undefined for any grade not in {K,1}. An unknown/typo'd grade silently disables monotonicity enforcement for all subsequent units (undefined < n is false; Math.max(n, undefined) is NaN, which poisons the running max). Add explicit validation that every skill.grade and scope unit.grade is a known value, and generalize the monotonicity error message beyond the hardcoded K/grade-1 wording for when grade 2+ lands. Also add a POSITIVE test that a valid K-then-grade-1 scope ordering passes (currently only the violation case is unit-tested; the happy path leans on content:validate, which has no grade-1 units yet).
acceptance_criteria: content-validate fails on an unknown skill.grade or unit.grade value; a valid multi-grade (K then 1) scope-sequence passes a new unit test; existing content still validates.
notes: Severity LOW (F-1/F-2/F-3 from .agents/snapshots/rw-385-adversarial-review-2026-06-14.md). NOT a PR #36 merge blocker. Naturally pairs with Phase 2 grade-1 work (rw-1gz.8.4) since that's when multi-grade scope first exists. Pre-existing GRADE_ORDER undefined pattern also at content-validate.ts line ~85.

title: content-validate test: startup-restore safety for file mutation harness
description: R2-F7 from rw-1jk adversarial review round 2 (2026-06-12). scripts/content-validate.test.ts mutates real content files (manifest.json, audio/manifest.json) and restores them in afterEach. If the process crashes mid-test, the working tree is left dirty. Minor crash-safety risk. Harden the harness (e.g. restore on process exit / try-finally around the whole suite, or write to a temp copy) so an aborted run can't leave mutated content files behind.
acceptance_criteria: An aborted/crashed validator-test run does not leave content/manifest.json or content/audio/manifest.json mutated; restore is guaranteed.
notes: Same root cause as rw-cvr (both stem from content-validate.test.ts mutating real content/ files). FIX TOGETHER with rw-cvr: an injected/temp content root means the real files are never written, so an aborted run can't leave them dirty. Origin: R2-F7 from rw-1jk adversarial review round 2 (.agents/snapshots/rw-1jk-adversarial-review-round-2-2026-06-12.md). Not a PR #35 merge blocker.
close_reason: Validator test harness no longer writes real content files; crashes cannot leave content/manifest.json or content/audio/manifest.json mutated.

title: content-validate: enforce grade monotonicity in scope-sequence
description: R2-F6 from rw-1jk adversarial review round 2 (2026-06-12). The cross-unit prerequisite ordering check in scripts/content-validate.ts uses a global scope-array index, which is only correct because scope-sequence.json happens to list all K units before grade-1 units (convention, not enforced). Before Phase 2 grade-1 scope lands, add an explicit check that every K unit precedes every grade-1 unit in scope-sequence.json so the global-index assumption is validated rather than assumed.
acceptance_criteria: content-validate fails if any grade-1 unit appears before a K unit in scope-sequence.json; existing content passes; test added.
